review.title: Add internal Accessibility selector engine
review.author: zhanghao1903
reviewed_scope: Exact 59c6fb5-to-e86181a six-commit remediation delta and all 31 changed paths
Current-head revalidation of all fourteen prior findings across selector, worker, WeChat, package, documentation, and review-result boundaries
Full base-to-head reconciliation of the public selector contract, collection extraction, mutation recovery, privacy, failure routing, packaging, and lifecycle evidence
Exact-head clean-clone package/root tests, adversarial tests, compilation, release preflight, wheel checks, report validation, GitHub CI, and PR merge state
excluded_scope: Fresh real WeChat or macOS Accessibility mutation
Signed or notarized helper execution and real TestPyPI or PyPI publication
Private raw desktop observations and unrelated dirty primary-worktree files
Repository-wide strict-mypy cleanup outside this feature

delta_review.summary: The six-commit delta records the prior request-changes decision, implements most planned remediation, repairs the historical approval evidence chain, and records exact-head verification. PRR-026 remains open; fresh forward-risk review found PRR-037 through PRR-039, and the platform lifecycle state regressed PRR-023.
delta_review.evidence: Complete two-dot delta and base-to-head diffs, source and caller audit, current-head adversarial tests, full clean-clone suites, packaging checks, review-result validation, and exact-head GitHub metadata

finding_revalidation.evidence: The shared proof collector now traverses all known roots and nested containers with presence-sensitive validation; malformed or conflicting attempt/dispatch copies block every fallback caller.
Resolver truncation returns before candidate construction, pick, or cache publication; fallback truncation propagates and the exact-self cache exception accepts only one-node limit truncation.

The collector now sees known copies, but legacy explicit-unsupported and pre-dispatch branches still accept semantically contradictory performed/unknown effects and native code -25204, producing a second click.

The corrected f19cbd9 result preserves finding fingerprints, uses the required two-dot range, covers every reviewed path with a risk surface, and binds runs only to their actual head; the current validator reports VALID.
Collection item and field selectors receive executable defaults and validation rejects unsupported extra steps, roots, pick/cache/fallback/confidence, or relation semantics.
The override TOML is parsed once and both generic selector profile and WeChat control map must validate before the pair becomes active; either half-invalid override falls back as one pair.
Extraction counts accepted semantic items, skips invalid rows without consuming the limit, and derives hasMore from one accepted-item lookahead.
Generated query, action, and tree workers accept only the current visible non-terminated frontmost app and reject bundle/name mismatch before AXUIElementCreateApplication.
Normal query/action/click/observe evidence, events, and default redacted logs use operation-specific allowlists; raw AX content remains available only through explicit raw inspection output.
Collection item and batch query limits share the public maximum of 500; maximum-page regressions prove requests remain accepted without dropping semantic field coverage.
Failure routing classifies exact diagnostic failure kind and cause before message fallback and maps truncation to wechat_query_truncated.
All four query/action worker failure kinds are constants, exports, stable registry entries, producer values, and package-boundary test expectations.
Generated native unsupported observations still preserve the exact requested action through client and protocol normalization.
accessibility_action_unsupported remains declared in the stable computer-use failure registry and public package boundary.

checks: Trace truncation before candidate construction, pick, fallback, and cache publication
Reject every collection selector property not executed by the extractor
Exercise rejected leading rows, semantic lookahead, maximum limits, fallback truncation, and exact-self cache validation

forward_risk_review.surface: Frontmost Accessibility target and public worker failures
forward_risk_review.reason: Native generated workers can observe or mutate another process and emit public failure kinds consumed across package boundaries.
checks: Run generated query/action/tree workers with a usable background target while another app is frontmost
Trace every emitted query/action worker failure through constant, registry, export, package import, and test

forward_risk_review.reason: An optional local override controls both generic selector resolution and WeChat fast-path action targets.
checks: Test invalid generic/valid control-map and valid generic/invalid control-map overrides
Verify a valid override is stored by the tool as one selector asset pair

forward_risk_review.surface: WeChat mutation proof, privacy, and failure routing
forward_risk_review.reason: The remediation changes the evidence that can authorize a second desktop mutation, normal observability output, and caller-visible failure classification.
checks: Exercise complete, missing, malformed, duplicated, conflicting, and request-mismatched proof in every known container and assert operation count/order
Inject private AX canaries beyond semantic limits and inspect evidence, progress/final events, and redacted logs
Route contradictory structured cause/message combinations and truncation through public WeChat failures

forward_risk_review.surface: Review contract and feature lifecycle evidence
forward_risk_review.reason: The delta changes technical contracts, historical/current review artifacts, verification records, and merge-readiness claims used for governance.
checks: Validate both historical/current machine results against schema 1.1 and re-review invariants
Reconcile exact two-dot delta, full base-to-head diff, result hashes, current-head runs, and GitHub CI
Keep implementation claims distinct from the current independent review decision

independent_pass.reviewer: three parallel independent passes plus primary reproduction
independent_pass.summary: Track A kept PRR-026 open. Fresh computer-use and WeChat/lifecycle passes found bundle/name rejection, undeclared target failures, truncated contact-target mutation, and regressed platform lifecycle state; the primary reviewer reproduced each code blocker.

decision.rationale: Eleven previous blockers are resolved, but PRR-026 still permits a second mutation from contradictory known evidence. PRR-037 rejects a correct frontmost bundle on localized-name mismatch, PRR-038 leaves the resulting package-owned failures outside the stable registry, PRR-039 mutates from truncated contact-target candidate sets, and PRR-023 again leaves live F6 platform state obsolete. Green exact-head tests and CI do not exercise these counterexamples.

summary: The remediation closes eleven of the twelve open blockers from 59c6fb5 and keeps PRR-022/025 resolved, but PRR-026 remains unsafe. Fresh review found three additional code blockers in frontmost identity, failure registration, and truncated contact-target mutation, and reopened the stale F6 platform-state finding PRR-023. Exact-head tests and CI are green, but the PR is not mergeable under this review contract.

findings.title: Known diagnostics and protocol evidence are excluded from the no-replay proof
findings.observation: Resolved: all supported top-level, metadata, observation, evidence, error, diagnostics, transport, and nested action containers now participate in one presence-sensitive consistency graph.
findings.trigger: A known proof container is missing, malformed, or conflicts with another action-attempt or dispatch copy.
findings.impact: The result now fails closed before any click, Return, focus, or strategy fallback, preventing a second mutation after an unknown or contradictory first outcome.

evidence.description: Known-container complete, conflict, malformed, and attempt/dispatch matrix tests assert downstream operation count and order.

findings.remediation: Completed by traversing the allowlisted proof graph and treating any malformed container or inconsistent value as invalid evidence.
findings.verification: Focused WeChat adversarial selection passed, including every known proof container and shared fallback entry point.

findings.title: A truncated selector query can still resolve and cache a candidate
findings.observation: Resolved: any decision-critical truncated query returns before candidates are created, picked, or cached, and truncated fallbacks propagate without trying later fallbacks.
findings.trigger: A query returns at least one candidate but reports limit/time truncation.
findings.impact: No hidden better or ambiguous candidate can be selected or cached for a later mutation.

evidence.description: Candidate-present truncation, cache state, fallback propagation, and narrow exact-self cache probes pass.

findings.remediation: Completed by moving truncation handling ahead of candidate construction and limiting the cache validation exception to one exact node with limit truncation.
findings.verification: Focused selector tests passed for hidden candidates, fallback order, cache publication, and truncation reasons.

findings.title: Known action evidence still authorizes replay with a contradictory outcome
findings.observation: The collector now checks types and duplicate consistency, but legacy explicit-unsupported and retryable pre-dispatch branches do not validate cross-field semantics before authorizing fallback.
findings.trigger: An unsupported_operation or retryable requestDispatched=false result includes actionEffect=performed, actionEffect=unknown, or nativeErrorCode=-25204 while actionAttempted is absent or false.
findings.impact: A result that does not prove no effect can be followed by a coordinate/selector click or Return, violating the documented no-replay boundary.

evidence.description: Three legacy known-evidence cases each returned success and executed accessibility_action followed by click.
A claimed pre-dispatch result with actionEffect=performed and nativeErrorCode=-25204 also executed a second click.
Performed, unknown, -25204, missing, malformed, and contradictory proof must never permit another mutation.

findings.remediation: Validate one semantically coherent proof. Allow fallback only for the complete native definite-no-effect pair or a proven pre-dispatch result with no contradictory attempted/effect/code evidence.
findings.verification: Exercise every shared fallback caller over absent, malformed, conflicting, performed, unknown, wrong-code, retryable, and dispatch combinations; every unsafe case must execute zero fallback mutations.

findings.title: The committed approval result is invalid under the current review contract
findings.observation: Resolved: the historical result keeps all preserved fingerprints, uses the required two-dot range, covers every reviewed path, and records only tests actually executed at the reviewed head.
findings.trigger: A maintainer or automation validates the f19cbd9 review result and its predecessor chain.
findings.impact: The historical decision is now machine-auditable; broader tests from another head remain narrative support rather than falsified reviewer runs.

evidence.description: The current schema/invariant validator reports VALID and the corrected JSON hash is recorded in lifecycle docs.

findings.remediation: Completed by correcting fingerprints, delta syntax, risk-path coverage, run-head bindings, and downstream status references without changing the historical decision.
findings.verification: Both f19cbd9 and its current 59c6fb5 successor validate at exact head e86181a.

findings.title: Collection extraction silently ignores selector steps after the first
findings.observation: Resolved: collection item and field selector definitions are accepted only when their single executable step, root, pick, cache, fallback, confidence, and relation policy matches the extractor.
findings.trigger: An override declares a multi-step or otherwise unsupported collection selector.
findings.impact: Configuration now fails validation instead of silently querying a different element path.

evidence.description: Parser-default and ignored-semantics rejection tests cover item and field selector variants.

findings.remediation: Completed by applying executable defaults during parse and rejecting all collection semantics not implemented by the extractor.
findings.verification: Focused profile tests passed for accepted defaults and each rejected unsupported property.

findings.title: Selector profile and control-map overrides do not activate atomically
findings.observation: Resolved: one TOML parse produces an immutable pair only after both generic selectors and the WeChat control map validate; any failure falls back to the packaged pair.
findings.trigger: An override is valid for only one of the two selector consumers.
findings.impact: The tool cannot combine packaged navigation with override action paths or the reverse.

evidence.description: Both half-valid override directions and a valid pair identity test pass.

findings.remediation: Completed by introducing WeChatSelectorAssets and routing all loaders and tool construction through the atomic pair.
findings.verification: Focused WeChat profile tests passed for invalid control map, invalid generic selector, and valid override activation.

findings.title: Collection pagination applies the caller limit before semantic acceptance
findings.observation: Resolved: extraction skips invalid raw rows, counts only accepted semantic records, and scans for one accepted lookahead before calculating hasMore.
findings.trigger: Leading or interleaved AX rows lack required fields before the requested semantic page fills.
findings.impact: Callers receive the requested number of valid records when available and coherent hasMore/partial diagnostics otherwise.

evidence.description: Rejected-leading-row and accepted-lookahead tests pass without raw-row limit consumption.

findings.remediation: Completed by separating bounded item scanning from semantic acceptance and deriving pagination from accepted items.
findings.verification: Focused collection tests passed for skipped rows, full pages, hasMore, and conservative truncation.

findings.title: Bundle targeting can execute an Accessibility action in a background app
findings.observation: Resolved: query, action, and tree scripts select only the current visible non-terminated frontmost application and reject requested bundle/name mismatch before creating an AX application element.
findings.trigger: The requested target is running in the background while another application is frontmost.
findings.impact: No generated Accessibility query or mutation is sent to a background target.

evidence.description: Generated query/action/tree workers fail closed with a usable background target and a different frontmost app.

findings.remediation: Completed by removing background-app enumeration and centralizing strict frontmost usability and identity checks in each generated script.
findings.verification: The generated-worker counterexample test passed at exact head e86181a.

findings.title: Normal selector evidence and events expose raw AX content beyond the semantic limit
findings.observation: Resolved: query, action, click, and observe operations publish explicit safe envelopes and diagnostic allowlists rather than republishing raw low-level observations.
findings.trigger: A selector backend scans private AX labels, descriptions, values, titles, or paths beyond the returned semantic page.
findings.impact: Private canaries do not escape through evidence, progress/final events, summaries, or default redacted logs.

evidence.description: Semantic-limit and execute-action privacy tests inspect normal evidence and observability channels for private AX canaries.

findings.remediation: Completed with operation-specific allowlists; explicit inspect_window rawQueries remains the only intentional raw query surface.
findings.verification: Focused privacy tests passed for evidence, progress/final events, summaries, and LoggingToolObserver(redact_text=True).

findings.title: Maximum collection pages generate batch query limits rejected by the public client
findings.observation: Resolved: item and field batch queries are capped by the shared MAX_ACCESSIBILITY_QUERY_LIMIT of 500 and conservative truncation prevents false completeness.
findings.trigger: A caller requests the collection maximum and many field nodes are present.
findings.impact: The public client accepts generated batch requests and the extractor does not silently claim complete output beyond its bound.

evidence.description: Maximum collection batch tests route limits through the real public normalizer and assert every query remains within 500.

findings.remediation: Completed by sharing the public bound and limiting batch lookahead while preserving field extraction and truncation diagnostics.
findings.verification: Focused maximum-page and query-normalizer tests passed.

findings.title: WeChat selector failure routing does not treat structured diagnostics as authoritative
findings.observation: Resolved: exact diagnostic failure kind and cause determine truncation, permission, timeout, or transport routing before message text is considered.
findings.trigger: Structured diagnostics and a free-text message imply different recovery categories.
findings.impact: Callers receive the authoritative stable failure kind, status, retryability, and recovery hint, including wechat_query_truncated.

evidence.description: Structured cause/message contradiction and truncation routing matrices pass.

findings.remediation: Completed by exact structured classification with free-text fallback only when no known structured category is present.
findings.verification: Focused failure-routing tests passed for permission, timeout, transport, truncation, and generic query causes.

findings.title: New query and action worker failures are absent from the stable package registry
findings.observation: Resolved: query/action worker failed and empty-response values are named constants, registry members, package exports, and generated producer values.
findings.trigger: A warm query or action worker exits or emits no response and the result crosses the public package/protocol boundary.
findings.impact: Application callers and package contract tests can classify every emitted worker failure without an undeclared value.

evidence.description: Producer-to-registry/export package test covers all four generated worker failures.

findings.remediation: Completed by declaring, registering, exporting, and testing all four values.
findings.verification: Focused public failure registry test and full computer-use package suite passed.

findings.title: The real native unsupported producer now includes action
findings.observation: Still resolved: the native unsupported producer includes the exact validated action and normalization preserves it.
findings.trigger: AXPress or AXSetFocus returns its definite unsupported native code.
findings.impact: The WeChat consumer can bind a compatibility fallback to the exact outbound action.

evidence.description: Generated production-worker tests preserve both native unsupported action/code pairs.

findings.remediation: Previously completed; current changes preserve the producer and consumer contract.
findings.verification: Full computer-use and WeChat package suites pass at e86181a.

findings.title: The new package failure remains in the stable routing tuple
findings.observation: Still resolved: accessibility_action_unsupported remains a stable declared and exported failure value.
findings.trigger: A definite native no-effect result crosses the computer-use package boundary.
findings.impact: Consumers retain compatible failure routing and can distinguish definite unsupported from unknown action failure.

evidence.description: Public failure registry and package-boundary tests include accessibility_action_unsupported.

findings.remediation: Previously completed; the expanded worker registry keeps this value intact.
findings.verification: Full package, wheel import/API, and release preflight checks pass.

findings.title: Correct bundle identity is rejected by a legitimate localized app name
findings.observation: After the exact frontmost bundle matches, query and action workers still require localizedName to equal targetApp. The WeChat adapter always sends both fields while supported profiles recognize WeChat and 微信 aliases.
findings.trigger: The request carries targetApp=WeChat and bundleId=com.tencent.xinWeChat while the same frontmost bundle exposes the legitimate localized name 微信.
findings.impact: Every selector query and Accessibility action fails before AXUIElementCreateApplication, disabling supported WeChat workflows on that localization.

evidence.description: Real generated query/action scripts rejected the correct bundle with failures accessibility_query_target_app_not_frontmost and target_app_not_frontmost; createApplication remained zero.
Bundle identifier is authoritative and name is the explicit fallback only when no bundle was requested.

findings.remediation: Make an exact requested bundle match authoritative, or pass and validate an explicit supported alias set. Use name-only matching only when no bundle was requested.
findings.verification: Run generated query/action workers for correct bundle plus different supported alias, name-only fallback, wrong bundle, wrong name-only target, hidden/terminated app, and no frontmost app.

findings.title: Frontmost-target failure values bypass the stable public registry
findings.observation: Generated query, action, and tree workers emit accessibility_query_target_app_not_frontmost, target_app_not_frontmost, and accessibility_tree_target_app_not_frontmost. None has a public constant or stable registry entry; target_not_frontmost is a different helper value.
findings.trigger: Any frontmost guard rejects a missing, hidden, terminated, bundle-mismatched, or name-mismatched target and the result crosses the package boundary.
findings.impact: Consumers using the advertised stable tuple cannot exhaustively route real package-owned failures and may treat them as unknown.

evidence.description: The query and action producer values normalized to top-level ToolObservation failures with registry membership false.
Tree exposes its operation-specific value as accessibility.treeFailureKind, and the existing registry source test does not scan generated-script fail literals.

findings.remediation: Choose a canonical public contract: normalize all three to TARGET_NOT_FRONTMOST, or declare, export, and register the operation-specific values. Synchronize docs and consumers.
findings.verification: Execute real generated producers and assert every caller-visible package-owned failure is declared once, importable from built wheels, documented, and registry-routable.

findings.title: Truncated contact-target queries still execute a mutation

location.symbol: direct contact-target query and mutation paths

findings.observation: Control-map target, visible-row target, and search-result paths inspect candidates and then click, execute an Accessibility action, or press Return without first rejecting diagnostics.truncated=true.
findings.trigger: A bounded or time-limited query returns zero or one matching contact while reporting truncation and another same-named candidate was not scanned.
findings.impact: An incomplete candidate set is treated as unique and can open the wrong same-named conversation; composite draft/send flows can then target the wrong recipient.

evidence.description: A truncated one-candidate control-map response returned success and executed open_app, observe, accessibility_query, accessibility_action, and verification query.
The visible-row and search-result paths have the same missing pre-mutation truncation gate; the search zero-candidate branch presses Return.

findings.remediation: Centralize a mutation-target query gate that maps decision-critical truncation to wechat_query_truncated before candidate ranking or action. Never fall through to Return or another mutation with an incomplete set.
findings.verification: Cover zero, one, and multiple returned candidates for limit, time, and depth truncation across all three paths and assert zero click, Accessibility action, Return, draft, and submit operations.

findings.title: F6 platform records again publish obsolete review state
findings.observation: The live GitHub body still publishes the f19cbd9 APPROVE decision and CI 29463591047, while current head is e86181a and the tracked F6 description records the later 59c6fb5 request-changes state and remediation verification.
findings.trigger: A maintainer or automation uses the canonical PR body to decide readiness, approval, or merge.
findings.impact: Platform and repository surfaces publish contradictory decisions, finding ledgers, and CI evidence, breaking the auditable F6 lifecycle gate.

evidence.description: Fresh gh pr view returned head e86181a, exact-head CI 29519769061, and an obsolete body claiming f19cbd9 approval.
Tracked pr-description.md is 8,158 bytes with SHA-256 a0aad7b42a03e9e1e1b8d906d721d80f1141f0f7dbadc68cda707596bec18a7c and does not match the live body.

findings.remediation: After code findings are fixed and re-reviewed, synchronize merge-readiness, tracked PR description, live GitHub body, finding ledger, current decision, and exact-head CI before changing draft state.
findings.verification: All canonical F6 surfaces agree on the current snapshot, findings, decision, behavior, and CI; tracked and live PR descriptions match where applicable.

required_actions.action: Collect and validate all known attempted/dispatch proof containers and prove zero replay across every shared fallback caller.
Require one semantically coherent fallback proof and reject performed, unknown, wrong-code, contradictory, or unsafe pre-dispatch evidence across every shared fallback caller.
Repair the committed f19cbd9 machine result and all downstream integrity/status references, then obtain exact-head CI.
Fail closed and avoid caching when a decision-critical selector query is truncated; add hidden-candidate regressions.
Implement complete collection selector semantics or reject unsupported definitions before any query.
Activate selector profile and control map from one validated source transaction and add split-override regressions.
Paginate over accepted semantic items with bounded lookahead and coherent hasMore behavior.
Require the exact requested app to be currently frontmost before any generated Accessibility query, action, or tree work.
Replace normal raw Accessibility observations with an allowlisted privacy-safe evidence/event schema and add canary regressions.
Bound collection batch queries to the public limit without dropping semantic field coverage.
Route exact structured selector failure kinds and causes before any free-text fallback heuristic.
Declare, export, and register all four emitted query/action worker failure kinds with producer-to-wheel tests.
Restore bundle-first frontmost identity semantics and add executable generated-worker coverage for supported localized aliases.
Normalize or publicly declare, export, register, document, and producer-test every frontmost-target failure value.
Reject all truncated contact-target candidate sets before click, Accessibility action, Return, draft, or send and add operation-count regressions for every path.
After code fixes and replacement review, synchronize merge-readiness, tracked PR description, live GitHub body, finding ledger, decision, and exact-head CI.

risks.description: PRR-026 can authorize a second mutation from contradictory known action evidence.
risks.mitigation: Require a semantically coherent no-effect or pre-dispatch proof and operation-count regressions for every shared fallback caller.

risks.description: PRR-039 can treat a truncated contact set as unique and open a wrong same-named conversation before a composite send workflow.
risks.mitigation: Fail closed on truncation before every contact-target mutation and prove zero click/action/Return/draft/submit operations.

risks.description: PRR-037 and PRR-038 reject a supported localized alias and publish package-owned failures outside the advertised stable registry.
risks.mitigation: Restore bundle-first matching and establish one declared producer-to-wheel failure contract.

risks.description: PRR-023 leaves the live GitHub body on an obsolete approval while tracked F6 records and the current head differ.
risks.mitigation: Synchronize all F6 surfaces only after code fixes and replacement review.

risks.description: Signed-helper, notarization, and package publication were not exercised during this merge review.
risks.mitigation: Keep them as explicit F7 release gates and do not infer release readiness from this exact-head merge review.

risks.description: The request-changes decision is immutable-snapshot evidence and expires if base or head changes.
risks.mitigation: Renew review and exact-head CI after any additional commit, including a commit that tracks this report on the PR branch.
